<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PeriodPlanning" name="Upcoming period planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline department objectives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan for strategic alignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" name="Are adjustments required?" default="Flow_NoAdjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain stakeholder approval for adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed" name="Budget distributed and implementation begun">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_PeriodPlanning" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentDecision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentRequired" name="Adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" name="No further adjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
